evidence.title: GitHub - raphaelsalaja/userinterface-wiki: A Living Manual for Better Interfaces

name: userinterface.wiki
summary: Interactive demos of UI, motion and UX principles, plus a 152-rule skill for AI coding agents.
description: A living manual for better interfaces. The demos collect interactive examples — the 12 principles of animation, animating container bounds, laws of UX (Doherty, Fitts, Hick, Miller, Postel), morphing icons, sounds on the web, pseudo elements and springs. The rules behind them are also distilled into a 152-rule agent skill that installs into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents.
contains: interactive demos: 12 principles of animation, container bounds, laws of UX, morphing icons, sounds on the web, springs
